mtfb: Since August: one hundred and twenty-five fact finds. Every month, more clients confirm and sign. October was our best yet: fifteen confirmed, twenty-five signed.

Your fact finds have a journey too. The plan goes to your client the same day. A reminder on day three, another on day eight, then we ask you to call. More than half of all confirmations came after a reminder, and thirty of thirty-two ratings are five stars.

When a fact find stalls, your own notes tell us why: the client wants time, or the budget is tight. After the call we ask you to make, six more said yes, five within hours. Sixteen are still waiting. Let's call them this week.
